rows.text: At the height of the Second Emperor's War, the Evolutionists aimed to take out Rubert II with a bio-weapon: a synthetic virus designed to target inorganic life and fry their central processors while sparing allies. The IPC fleet deployed the virus across 27 suspected hideouts, but every attempt failed. Project leader Dr. Rama, terrified of a retaliatory bio-strike, spent the rest of his life obsessing over virus prevention. His research never changed the war's tide. To Rubert II, the star-shattering beams fired by Killing Machines remained the ultimate Anti-Organic Virus.
